axes.label: Average tenure
axes.note: Company-reported average across all employees, weighted by male and female headcount.

axes.label: Tenure gap (M−F)
axes.note: Positive means men stay longer. Negative means women do.

axes.label: Average pay per employee
axes.note: As filed. Bonus and option treatment differs by company; holding companies count head office only.

axes.label: Female pay / male pay
axes.note: 100% means equal. Lower means the female average is lower.

axes.label: Longest-serving CEO
axes.note: Where a company has several representative directors, the longest-serving one is used.

axes.label: Years since incorporation
axes.note: From the incorporation date on file, not the listing date.

axes.label: Market cap per employee
axes.note: Latest KRX market capitalisation divided by headcount as filed to DART. Joined on ticker; unlisted names or those with no traded close are left null, not zero.

axes.label: Market capitalisation
axes.note: Latest KRX close × shares outstanding, as of the price date on the valuation tape.

axes.label: Price to book (PBR)
axes.note: Market cap ÷ total equity, most recent annual filing. Null where total equity is zero or negative.

axes.label: Return on equity (ROE)
axes.note: Net income ÷ total equity, most recent annual filing. Null where total equity is zero or negative.

axes.label: Interest coverage
axes.note: Operating income ÷ finance costs. A value under 1 means operating profit does not cover interest expense. Null where finance costs are zero or not filed.

axes.label: Borrowings / equity
axes.note: Short-term + long-term borrowings + bonds, divided by total equity. This is interest-bearing debt only, not total liabilities. Null where none of the three borrowing lines were filed, or total equity is zero or negative.
